description:
First Phase 4 child. Bring `apps/octo_pi_tui/` up from empty to
boot-ready.

- mix.exs: app :octo_pi_tui, deps on octo_pi_coder (in_umbrella).
- lib/octo_pi/tui.ex: public facade (empty body for now).
- lib/octo_pi/tui/application.ex: supervision tree stubs for:
    - OctoPi.Tui.Terminal (raw mode + SIGWINCH owner) — not started
      until interactive mode kicks in, so an empty children list
      is fine for now; comment out the eventual child spec.
    - OctoPi.Tui.Events (Registry for resize/etc broadcast).
- lib/octo_pi/tui/raw_mode.ex: thin wrapper around
  `:shell.start_interactive({:noshell, :raw | :cooked})`.
- test/test_helper.exs + test/octo_pi/tui_test.exs with a trivial
  contract test (module exists, Registry boots).

No Terminal GenServer yet — that lands in .2.

TDD:
- `OctoPi.Tui` module is defined.
- `OctoPi.Tui.Events` Registry is started at app boot.
- `RawMode.enter/0` + `RawMode.exit/0` compile.
title: Scaffold octo_pi_tui app + supervision tree
